company.name: AiPrise
company.shortDescription: AiPrise provides a compliance platform to verify businesses and individuals globally.
company.description: AiPrise provides a compliance platform and API integration for verifying businesses and individuals across many countries to mitigate risk and prevent fraud. The platform includes solutions for Know Your Business (KYB), Know Your Customer (KYC), and ongoing fraud monitoring with customizable rule engines. AiPrise also offers a Compliance Co-pilot, an AI-assisted tool for case review, document analysis, and Enhanced Due Diligence report generation.

productsAndServices.description: Verifies the legitimacy and details of businesses globally using registry data, ownership verification, and social signals to support compliance and risk management.
productsAndServices.name: Business Verification

productsAndServices.description: Verifies individual identities worldwide using document checks, biometric selfies, and local ID documents to ensure compliance and reduce fraud.

productsAndServices.description: Assesses fraud risk by analyzing email, phone, device data, and social signals with customizable rules to detect and prevent fraudulent activity.
